1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Extract one diamond from one voxel pocket. The mine has no lava or fragile support and allows four spare pick strikes.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Extract two hidden diamonds from two view-bound pockets. One lava block is present and five spare pick strikes are available.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Extract three hidden diamonds across three viewpoints while avoiding lava and fragile support. Four spare strikes are available.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Extract four hidden diamonds across all viewpoints while avoiding lava and fragile support. No extra occluding screen is present and four spare strikes are available.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Extract the current four diamonds across all viewpoints. An extra screen hides the first pocket and only two spare strikes remain.
